item.title: Four new astronauts arrive at the International Space Station to replace NASA's evacuated crew
item.description: The International Space Station is back to full strength with the arrival of four new astronauts. SpaceX delivered the U.S., French and Russian astronauts to the orbiting lab on Saturday.

item.title: Trump says change in power in Iran 'would be the best thing that could happen'
item.description: President Donald Trump says a change in power in Iran “would be the best thing that could happen” as the U.S. administration weighs whether to take military action against Tehran.

item.title: Super Soggy Sunday
item.description: Sunday is looking like a wet day with a deep soaking on tap for many of us. Rain will be with us through most of the day.
